# Code of Conduct

This project follows the spirit of Ruby's classic community principle:

Matz is nice and so we are nice.

## Be Nice

Treat people with kindness, patience, and respect. Disagreement is fine, but keep
discussion focused on ideas, code, and outcomes rather than personal attacks.

## Be Welcoming

Help make the project a place where people can ask questions, learn, and
contribute without fear of ridicule or hostility.

## Be Considerate

Remember that other people have different backgrounds, constraints, and levels of
context. Explain decisions clearly and assume good intent when possible.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove comments, close threads, block users, or take other action
needed to keep the project healthy.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately by emailing hello+security@sergiodxa.com.
